fallback_self_exit.route: If ordinary UI cannot dismiss, a separately reviewed owned-fixture self-exit action is safer than introducing an arbitrary/external PID kill command. For example an explicitly labeled owned diagnostic UI action queues a bounded exit-request marker then invokes original _exit(0) on its own process.

fallback_self_exit.identity_safety: Self-exit has no PID-target/reuse race and cannot terminate another app. It changes testfixture behavior, so report as controlled self-exit process-cold rather than ordinary user force-quit.
fallback_self_exit.not_selected: Identity-checked external SIGTERM remains a standard API candidate but non-atomic PID revalidation and MAC permission uncertainty make it unnecessary if UI/self-exit suffices. Never arbitrary PID or escalation.
